question: In a certain code language, 'NOIDA' is written as *STNIF', and 'GOA' is written as 'LTF'. How will 'MEERUT' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/768ffa75a91f088695c16a6deb50b713a526fcdb17ebb80961c20654cb850baa.png] 

According to the alphabetical positions of the letters,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f516218e19bb6f3d454d175904d7506863743457a1853839394c8884f640e13a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebf7d4a9d702995d953452549d0da3e73598edde9ce54efc44f5355b1d45669b.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2b1c2cad0a6f1a0cf8becb519c56903bec35c72bc5811c8369a1d6fefcdbc82.png] 

Hence, ‘**RJJWZY**’ is the correct answer.
